segments.he: תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: תַּנּוּר וְכִירַיִם חֲדָשִׁים — הֲרֵי הֵן כְּכׇל הַכֵּלִים הַנִּטָּלִין בֶּחָצֵר. אֲבָל אֵין סָכִין אוֹתָם שֶׁמֶן, וְאֵין טָשִׁין אוֹתָן בְּמַטְלִית, וְאֵין מְפִיגִין אוֹתָן בְּצוֹנֵן כְּדֵי לְחׇסְמָן, וְאִם בִּשְׁבִיל לֶאֱפוֹת — הֲרֵי זֶה מוּתָּר.
segments.en: § «The Sages taught» in the Tosefta: «New ovens and stoves are similar to all vessels that» may be «carried in a courtyard» on a Festival, as one can place items on them. «However, one may not anoint them with oil, nor rub them with a rag, nor cool them with cold» liquids to «harden them», as all these actions are considered preparing the vessel for use, which may not be done on a Festival. «And if» one did so «in order to bake» in the oven on the Festival itself, «this is permitted.»

positions.claim: one may not anoint, rub or cool new ovens to harden them, but may if in order to bake
